summary: H06E maps every assigned recovery, live-acceptance and governance clause while deliberately preserving final host and release gates.
facts: All four task acceptance clauses and every clause of the four assigned program requirements are mapped to reviewed, executed facts.
No H06E evidence claims production installation, scheduler ownership, Claude live, native Windows or R2 completion.

acceptance.clause: 生命体在 5 秒内报告卡顿并在能力边界内处理孤儿锁、退出 actor、冲突 lane 与 runtime drift
acceptance.fact: H06E makes the Codex help observation stable across pipe and real PTY parents so a healthy unchanged runtime is not misclassified as drift; the accepted H03 liveness implementation remains unchanged and its runtime tests pass.

acceptance.clause: 干预有预算、有终态、有 receipt，不能扩大 allowed paths、静默换宿主或无限重试
acceptance.fact: Only the exact known complete warning is normalized; unknown diagnostics, bytes, executable, version, contract and generation drift fail closed, and the managed worker used one provider with six exact paths and terminal receipts.

acceptance.clause: status、doctor、repair、uninstall、rollback 与 pending decision 在普通 lane 不可用时仍可达
acceptance.fact: The shared probe contract is consumed by both installer sealing and runtime preflight, eliminating environment-class self-lock before approved recovery entry points while retaining installer rollback and readback tests.

acceptance.clause: 等待使用可更新状态卡和本地完整日志，满足 5/30 秒进度 SLA 且不重复输出轮询文案
acceptance.fact: H06E does not change progress rendering; managed execution retained cursor logs and terminal reports, while the existing recovery/status behavior remains covered by the integrated runtime suite.

acceptance.clause: I01-I19、并发、进程死亡、receipt tamper、world-state drift、只读账本、scheduler degraded 与 rollback 全部通过
acceptance.fact: H06E proves the Codex help-authority and installer rollback subset only; full I01-I19, concurrency and scheduler evidence remains an explicit final-successor obligation.

acceptance.clause: Codex 与 Claude 真实宿主、macOS 与 Windows 证据齐全前不得宣称 R2 完成或 production accepted
acceptance.fact: Real Codex 0.150.1 pipe and PTY evidence is present on macOS, but no Claude or native Windows evidence was manufactured; the task report explicitly denies R2 or production acceptance.

acceptance.clause: H00-H06 均有严格 owned paths、证据包、finding 处置和独立 reviewer，失败候选不合并
acceptance.fact: H06E retained run1 findings, issued repair1 under the same six-path authority, passed two independent reviews, and integrated only byte-identical reviewed outputs before evidence promotion.

acceptance.clause: G0-G6/T32 accepted 历史不被重建、重放或改写
acceptance.fact: H06E ran in an independent full clone and integrated only into the R2 coordinator branch; accepted predecessor events, dev/main, installed runtime and production state were not rewritten.
